items.markingKey: Format (1): a catchy title and the writer's name (byline). Content: introduction, body paragraphs with causes, effects or examples, and a conclusion with suggestions or a call to action. Content (2 marks): title and byline; meaning; examples; pressures to be dishonest; importance; conclusion. Expression (2 marks): fluency, accuracy of grammar and spelling, appropriate register and word limit.
